run_guided_backprop: run guided backprop on a model and input tensor to compute saliency maps
create_guided_backprop_relu: create a GuidedBackpropReLU autograd function that modifies ReLU backward pass for guided backprop
use_guided_backprop_context: use GuidedBackpropContext to manually apply guided backpropagation rules during gradient computation
get_example_data: get a pretrained model and sample image tensor with ImageNet category IDs for visualization
plot_example_saliency: plot input images alongside their saliency maps with method name and category labels
